items: K Rajaraman granted extension as Chairman of IFSCA beyond July 31, 2026 till age 65 (HQ: GIFT City).
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on appointee name, nominating body (FSIB / ACC), predecessor, tenure duration, and statutory establishment year.
